content_blocks.label: clause_1._Confidential_Information
content_blocks.text: ‘Confidential Information’ means any information disclosed by the Disclosing Party to the Receiving Party in writing, orally, or by other means that is designated as confidential.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Use_of_Confidential_Information
content_blocks.text: The Receiving Party agrees to use the Confidential Information solely for the purpose of evaluating a potential business relationship between the Parties.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Duration_of_Agreement
content_blocks.text: This Agreement shall remain in effect until the earlier of (a) five (5) years from the Effective Date, or (b) termination of the business relationship between the Parties.

content_blocks.label: notary_note
content_blocks.text: Sworn before me this 28th day of February 2024.
